entities.name: Samuel Alfred Mitchell
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Samuel Alfred Mitchell was a Canadian-American astronomer who studied solar eclipses and set up a program to use photographic techniques to determine the distance to stars at McCormick Observatory, where he served as the director.
